title: ONS 2026 Environmental Accounts residence and quality QA controls

facts.source_fact: ONS estimates 2024 UK residence-basis greenhouse-gas emissions at 478 MtCO2e.
facts.expected_handling: Tag the value as residence-basis and reference-year 2024.

facts.source_fact: Residence estimates include UK residents and UK-registered businesses whether activity occurs in the UK or overseas.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply territorial geography rules to residence records.

facts.source_fact: Residence estimates exclude foreign visitors and foreign businesses operating in the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Apply residence ownership/status rules before inclusion.

facts.source_fact: The residence basis matches the basis used for GDP and GVA, enabling direct comparison with economic indicators.
facts.expected_handling: Use residence-basis emissions for like-for-like economic intensity comparisons.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports 2024 residence emissions were 0.4% lower than 2023.
facts.expected_handling: Keep year-on-year change tied to the same measure and vintage.

facts.source_fact: The 2024 residence estimate was the lowest since current records began in 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Do not generalise the record-low claim to other accounting bases.

facts.source_fact: Households accounted for 25.9% of residence-basis emissions in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Keep household share within the residence-basis denominator.

facts.source_fact: The transport industry accounted for 16.3% of residence-basis emissions in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Use the ONS industry classification context when comparing transport shares.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports 140 tonnes CO2e per million pounds of economic activity in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the economic-price/measure context with intensity values.

facts.source_fact: Residence-basis emissions intensity was 72.0% lower than in 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute absolute-emissions change for intensity change.

facts.source_fact: Fossil fuels accounted for 77.7% of direct energy consumption in the reported 2024 accounts.
facts.expected_handling: Keep energy-consumption shares separate from emissions shares.

facts.source_fact: Renewable energy accounted for 15.3% of direct energy consumption in the reported 2024 accounts.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer an emissions percentage directly from the energy share.

facts.source_fact: Residence-basis GHG emissions were 41.8% lower in 2024 than in 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the 1990 baseline and residence accounting basis.

facts.source_fact: ONS attributes much of the long-run fall to a 67.4% decline in energy-industry emissions since 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Do not attribute the whole national decline to this single sector.

facts.source_fact: Industries collectively accounted for 74.1% of residence-basis emissions in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish the industry aggregate from individual industry shares.

facts.source_fact: Industry aggregations in the bulletin are based on UK SIC 2007.
facts.expected_handling: Require compatible classification before industry comparisons.

facts.source_fact: ONS notes the Air Emission Accounts data include direct residence-based emissions, corresponding to Scope 1 under GHG Protocol terminology.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label these data as full Scope 1+2+3 footprint emissions.

facts.source_fact: ONS identifies the Air Emissions estimates as accredited official statistics following independent review.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve accreditation status in source quality metadata.

facts.source_fact: ONS links a quality and methodology document describing strengths, limitations, methods, uses and users of air-emissions data.
facts.expected_handling: Expose methodological limitations alongside derived uses.

facts.source_fact: ONS distinguishes territorial, residence and footprint measures because they answer different questions and cover different scopes.
facts.expected_handling: Block direct substitution across accounting bases without an explicit reconciliation.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable accounting, monitoring or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference year, publication/update date and provisional/final status where applicable.
Carry source URL, publisher and method/provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert this method or regulatory rule into a parcel-level measured emission without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
